CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2469 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 2351c1c7bb6d71e455a7fd164f42f67091491d0f. Bus nonce: 7afa2927b864ae0cc10681c2c3af33cc. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 2351c1c7bb6d71e455a7fd164f42f67091491d0f`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 2351c1c7bb6d71e455a7fd164f42f67091491d0f` or `Fix review: blocked 2351c1c7bb6d71e455a7fd164f42f67091491d0f <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 7afa2927b864ae0cc10681c2c3af33cc`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2469 2351c1c7bb6d71e455a7fd164f42f67091491d0f") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2469-7afa2927`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Round 2 of R10-UPDATE-PR-LOCK, at head 2351c1c7. Round 1 at d2d361a4 was blocked claim-false on two counts:
- a detached `git gc --auto` inherited lock fd 9 and held the branch lock, giving a false BUSY that named a dead pid;
- pr-contract was red on an unrouted `## Forward-carry`.

The fixer's changes:
- The lock is now held by a single `python3 -I` holder process, which does not pass the lock fd to its children. The EXIT trap kills the holder, and the holder exits by itself if its parent dies. A BUSY on a dead pid says so.
- There is a new self-test arm, in which a post-checkout hook leaves a detached `sleep` behind. It fails on round 1's code and passes at the head. The new mutant is `mut:unlock`.
- `## Red checks` is re-taken from the check-runs API, and Forward-carry now reads `none`.
- prepr gains step 7a2, a carry-audit check.
- One residual (a SIGKILL of the shell pid alone) is routed as `Carry: dismissed: ...` because daemonize makes each run a session leader. Judge that dismissal.
- Folded in from the orchestrator: `cloud_relay.sh` wrote the PR body to a `$TMPDIR`-root `cloud_body.*`, which prepr's body-path check refused every time. The relay's auto update therefore never succeeded, yet it still raced manual runs. The body now goes in a per-run directory under the relay's state dir, which is always removed. There is a new self-test arm that checks the body path against prepr's `shared_root` function. Self-tests: cloud_relay 74/0 and pr_args 51/0.
- Relay-vs-manual probes in both orders: the second runner gets BUSY, and neither run loses its worktree.

Verify each claim adversarially:
- revert each fix and check that its arm fails;
- check the mutants;
- re-read CI at this head from the check-runs API;
- check the merge with origin/main.

Say that this is round 2.
